agent_explanation: Seeded sensor noise (~0.016) corrupts the state-feedback measurement while the pole starts slightly tilted with negative cart velocity. The controller applies wrong-direction/insufficient corrective force (only ~4.5 at step 20 rising to ~25 at step 28), allowing theta to grow monotonically from 0.027 to 0.427 (step 20) to 0.68 (step 25) to 0.83 (step 28). Removing noise alone stabilizes the run, proving noise-induced mis-estimation is the cause.
